best_idea: A zone's script is a file loaded by its id only when the zone is chosen (silent when absent), and a defend objective fails the zone only on the death of its tagged entity, with waves as frame-scheduled zone data.
decision_why: Take the parked-script loader and the defend-objective fail rule for zones; keep the waves as zone data with a fire cap; reject the text-only victory and the single-id role check, which conflict with the server-verified-kills and one-ledger rulings.
acceptance: A server test asserts an unknown zone id loads no script and raises no error; the death of a tracked objective entity fails the zone while an untracked unit's death does not; a looped wave with maxFires 3 spawns exactly 3 times over 4 periods.
